text:
R Programming Language R Studio: Download two text files each day, combine and find the percent of two columns 
There is a website that posts two text files each day that I need downloaded into R Studio. I need a short and simple script that will do the requirements below. 
Requirements 
Download both text files into R Studio 
Combine text files 
Calculate the percent of two columns 
Show only stocks that have total volume of over 1,000,000 and sort by percent 
Both files are the same format, and a sample output is below;
